:::{#sol-best-step-factor}

```{r}
#| label: best-step-factor-r
#| echo: false
bsf_eigs_ps <- c(1, 9)
bsf_kappa_ps <- max(bsf_eigs_ps) / min(bsf_eigs_ps)
bsf_rho_ps <- (bsf_kappa_ps - 1) / (bsf_kappa_ps + 1)
```

The [condition number](linear-algebra-special-matrices.qmd#def-condition-number) is
$\condnum(\matr{S}) = 9 / 1 = `{r} bsf_kappa_ps`$,
so by @thm-best-constant-step

$$
\convrate(\steplen^*) = \frac{`{r} bsf_kappa_ps` - 1}{`{r} bsf_kappa_ps` + 1} = `{r} bsf_rho_ps`.
$$

:::
